title: Workers lists every host with cores, temperature, steal and runs now, and an unreachable host as away
description: graphyard host add USER@HOST checks Docker over SSH and records the host; each loop cycle reads this machine and every added host (cores, hottest CPU sensor, steal, trial containers running now) and names them on its coordination read. /api/status serves them and the Workers page lists them in a Hosts table, this machine first; a host that does not answer reads Away and is read again next cycle. At 1280 px and 390 px.

steps.name: the loop reads every host and the control plane serves them
